prd.overview: This project aims to create an aesthetically pleasing fan page dedicated to Final Fantasy 7, featuring characters Cloud, Barret, and Tifa. The website will utilize AI-generated images to closely represent the characters and will include elements such as weapons and a game map, with a blurred background of Midgar to enhance the visual appeal.
goals: Create a visually appealing fan page that captures the essence of Final Fantasy 7.
Incorporate AI-generated images of characters Cloud, Barret, and Tifa.
Showcase weapons and a game map relevant to Final Fantasy 7.
Ensure the background features a blurred image of Midgar for aesthetic enhancement.
Provide a user-friendly interface for fans to explore content.
non_goals: Develop a full-fledged game or interactive experience.
Include characters or elements from outside the Final Fantasy 7 universe.
Create a mobile application version of the fan page.
Implement e-commerce functionalities for merchandise sales.
Focus on extensive lore or story analysis of the game.
target_users: Final Fantasy 7 fans looking for a dedicated fan page.
Gamers interested in character art and game maps.
Individuals seeking community engagement around Final Fantasy 7.
core_features_mvp: Homepage featuring AI-generated images of Cloud, Barret, and Tifa.
Gallery section showcasing weapons from the game.
Interactive game map of Final Fantasy 7.
Responsive design for accessibility on various devices.
nice_to_have_features: User comments section for fan interactions.
Social media sharing buttons for content promotion.
user_stories: As a user, I want to see high-quality images of Cloud, Barret, and Tifa so that I can appreciate their designs.
As a user, I want to explore a gallery of weapons from the game to learn more about them.
As a user, I want to navigate an interactive game map to understand the game's world better.
As a user, I want the website to have a blurred Midgar background to enhance the aesthetic experience.
As a user, I want to read character bios to connect more with the characters.
As a user, I want to share my favorite images on social media to engage with other fans.
As a user, I want to leave comments on the page to discuss my thoughts with others.
As a user, I want the website to be mobile-friendly so I can access it on my phone.
acceptance_criteria: The website must load within 3 seconds on standard internet connections.
All images must be AI-generated and closely resemble the characters.
The gallery must display at least 5 different weapons from the game.
The game map must be interactive and allow users to click on different locations.
The blurred Midgar background must be visually appealing and not distract from the main content.
technical_stack_recommendation: JavaScript for interactivity and dynamic content.
React or Vue.js for building a responsive user interface.
Node.js for backend services if needed.
payments_security_compliance: Ensure compliance with GDPR for user data protection if user accounts are implemented.
Follow CCPA guidelines for California residents if applicable.
Implement SSL certificates for secure data transmission.
assumptions: AI-generated images will be available and of high quality.
Users will have access to the internet to view the website.
The website will not require extensive backend functionalities at launch.
open_questions: What specific weapons should be showcased on the website?
